$comment: prores/1 batches that must (valid: true) or must not validate against spec/prores/prores-1.schema.json, and what a target keeps of each (expect: rows = rounds with a score, rankings, events = tournaments, stats = snapshots, values = statistics of the first; refused: invalid or too_large). rules: place_of (a page's finish -> {place, tied} or {result}, else null), tour_of (a world ranking's tour column -> a tour key or null), iso_week. names: whether a page's name is the player's (every part of the shorter among the other's, at least two).

cases.name: minimal
cases.why: A ranking alone.

cases.name: a_tour_page
cases.why: A tour's player page: the season ranking, two tournaments with their rounds (one missed cut, days named), the season statistics.

cases.name: a_world_ranking_page
cases.why: The world ranking's page: the rank and a tournament with its points, no rounds.

cases.name: confirmed_other_name
cases.why: The page writes her maiden name; she confirmed in the tool that it is hers.

cases.name: round_without_score
cases.why: A round the page lists without a score (withdrawn): no row.

cases.name: wrong_format
cases.why: Another format.

cases.name: no_site
cases.why: Which page is unknown.

cases.name: site_unknown
cases.why: A page the format doesn't know.

cases.name: no_player
cases.why: Whose page it is is unknown.

cases.name: no_account_ref
cases.why: Which page, unknown.

cases.name: local_time
cases.why: A time without its zone.

cases.name: too_many
cases.why: More tournaments than a batch carries: the client splits.

cases.name: ranking_without_value
cases.why: A ranking with neither rank nor points: left out.

cases.name: tournament_without_start
cases.why: A tournament with neither its start nor its week: left out with its rounds.

cases.name: statistic_as_text
cases.why: A statistic that is no number: that value left out.

cases.name: other_players
cases.why: Fields the format doesn't have (another player's line) are dropped.

cases.name: owgr_page
cases.why: The OWGR's page of the player: his rank, average points and divisor, his tournaments by week with place and points won, no rounds (a world ranking has none; a major names no tour).

cases.name: rolex_page
cases.why: The Rolex Rankings' page of the player: the same, the cut as MC.

cases.name: rounds_without_start
cases.why: Rounds of a tournament known only by its week: the rounds can't be placed on days, so they cost (counted failed); the tournament stays.

cases.name: no_such_week
cases.why: A week no year has: the tournament is left out.
